notes.title: Darius Cozmic Collection Arcade Update
notes.content:
Hello Darius fans!

Today's update comprises of the following:
[list][*]Added a screen adjustment function to Darius Gaiden
[*]Added ability to choose which screen to flip when using multiple monitors
[*]Added settings when using Direct Input controllers
[*]Added ability to adjust the window with a controller
[*]Fixed other minor issues[/list]
Enjoy, 
The Taito Steam team.
